test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

One who can read and write
solution:
The correct answer is '**Literate**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Literate**'.
 
• It means 'able to read and write'. (पढ़ने व लिखने में सक्षम)
 
 
• *Example: Kids on the edge of adolescence are increasingly computer **literate**.*
